about.title: About Me
about.p1: Agriculture graduate from Brawijaya University with strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. Experienced in research, data analysis, project coordination, and community-based activities.
about.p2: Detail oriented and adaptable, with a strong interest in sustainability, social development, and community engagement. I enjoy coordinating events, working in teams, and turning data into actionable insights.
about.p3: I thrive in collaborative environments and always seek to contribute positively — whether it's in research, operations, or community service.
